edges.subject: neuronal ceroid lipofuscinoses
edges.quote: Each form is caused by mutations in a different gene, resulting in lysosomal dysfunction, which, by largely unknown mechanisms, has a devastating impact on the central nervous system.

edges.subject: neuronal ceroid lipofuscinoses
edges.quote: The NCLs are grouped together owing to their broadly shared clinical presentations and the presence of autofluorescent storage material.

edges.subject: CLN2 disease
edges.quote: Since the development of enzyme replacement therapy for CLN2 disease, much has been learnt about the practicalities of its delivery.

edges.subject: neuronal ceroid lipofuscinoses
edges.quote: The rest of the body is also affected, with life-limiting disease in the bowel and effects on other body systems, which will also require treatment for maximal therapeutic benefit.
